*Imagine getting a whatsapp message after 3 months of continuous visit - to stop coming*

Reason - A basic expectation as a caregiver that my disabled mother should be assisted while she is asked to sit on a cycle for exercise!!

1. DONT ASK ANY QUESTION

3. ITS OK IF YOU HAVE TO WAIT 10/15 MINS DESPITE BEING THERE AT YOUR SCHEDULED TIME ( remember this is a daily long term affair)

4. A COMMON NARRATIVE IS - A LOT DEPENDS ON HOW MUCH EFFORTS A PATIENT PUTS AT HOME AND NOT JUST WHILE AT THE CENTER ( instead of motivating the patient to do exercise at home, they blame patient is no doing exercise at home - no proof ! As a caregiver I know the motivation and efforts put at home as well)

5. FOR A STROKE PATIENT THEY WILL INVEST 1.5 HOURS (kudos for the gimmick- but it includes lot of breaks/ patient sitting idle as one physio attend 2/3 other patient simultaneously) And THEN THEY REMIND YOU THAT THEY ARE PUTTING SO MUCH EFFORT AND TIME.

6. BE COMFORTABLE WHEN YOU HEAR - OTHER PATIENTS PAY MORE THAN YOU- FIND ANOTHER PLACE WHICH WILL INVEST 1.5 HOURS IN THIS AMOUNT

7. THEY TAKE MORE PATIENT IN THE SLOT GIVEN TO YOU, AND SAY JUST LIKE YOU WE OTHER PATIENT ALSO NEEDS ATTENTION ( it’s not wrong to work optimally- provided you put that much resource so that compromised care is not given)
